build.evidence: Vite production build completed and build artifacts are SHA-256 bound.

stateMachineUnitTests.evidence: 19 focused tests cover authoritative-input validation, legal and invalid transitions, restart, reachability, contract drift, and replay.

contractConformance.evidence: Runtime states, contracted transitions, terminal states, bearing IDs, and QA flags match the M4 contract.

desktopE2E.evidence: All edge, wait, and gap paths completed at 1440x900 with restart.

mobileE2E.evidence: All three paths completed at 390x844 with overflow and target-size checks.

keyboard.evidence: One branch completed keyboard-only; all bearing controls received logical focus.

touch.evidence: All branches completed with Playwright touch emulation; physical-device testing remains human/manual evidence.

reducedMotion.evidence: All branches completed under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce with semantic outcomes intact.

accessibilityAutomatedScan.evidence: Axe found no serious or critical violations in representative desktop/mobile states; automation is partial evidence only.

externalNetworkTest.evidence: Production path emitted no request outside 127.0.0.1.

consoleRuntimeErrors.evidence: No console errors or unhandled page errors were observed.

deterministicReplay.evidence: Fresh identical gap sequences produced identical state and semantic output.

assetProvenance.evidence: All creative assets are project-native and hashed; dependencies are separately classified.

warnings: Independent authorship and licensing cannot be proven solely by source inspection; the project-native provenance manifest is the auditable implementation attestation.
Human creative-success and full manual accessibility review remain outstanding by design.
Touch evidence is emulated rather than a physical-device observation.
Automated accessibility checks do not establish WCAG conformance.
limitations: Automation cannot establish aesthetic quality, emotional pacing, prose quality, perceived agency, or perceptual sufficiency; these remain human-playtest questions.
